levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Checklist items are skipped or rushed through without the guardian.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four checklist items are checked together with the guardian.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Proficient, and the learner notices and raises a problem the four-item checklist does not cover.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The job is marked complete even though a checklist piece is still unfinished.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Any unfinished piece is identified and completed before the job counts as done.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Proficient, and the learner explains exactly what made the piece incomplete in the first place.

lookFors: Disagreements between learner and guardian are resolved by rereading the plan's own wording, not by general judgment.
The check happens in the same space where the job occurred.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
